description: This Java class `CreditAllocationsJsonParser` is responsible for parsing JSON data related to credit allocations in a loan product context. It processes JSON commands to assemble loan product credit allocation rules, validates the data, and manages conversion of JSON elements into domain-specific objects.

classes.name: CreditAllocationsJsonParser
classes.description: A service class responsible for parsing JSON commands to create and validate credit allocation rules for loan products.

methods.name: assembleLoanProductCreditAllocationRules
methods.description: Parses the JSON command to assemble a list of LoanProductCreditAllocationRule objects and validates them.

methods.name: populateCreditAllocationRules
methods.description: Populates the allocation types in a CreditAllocationRule from JSON data.

methods.name: populateTransactionType
methods.description: Sets the transaction type of a credit allocation rule based on JSON data.

methods.name: getAllocationTypes
methods.description: Extracts and sorts allocation types from a JSON array.

methods.name: asIntegerOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to an Integer, or null if not present.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to a String, or null if not present.

methods.name: asJsonArrayOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JSON element to a JsonArray, or null if not present.
